column3: “at the foot of the mountain” renders “under the mountain.”
“we will be obedient” renders “we will hear.”
NASB supplies “there appeared to be”; “as clear as the sky itself” renders “like the very substance of the heavens for purity,” and “sapphire” may be lapis lazuli.
“beheld” renders a different verb for seeing (hazah) than “saw” in verse 10.
“whoever has a legal matter” renders “whoever is a master of matters.”
